decision.explanation: Different. Under the required calibrated rule, C04 is the nearest supplied condition at 7.61657 dB, followed by C03 at 7.822059 dB and C02 at 10.59642 dB (COMPARISON.WELCH). The nearest distance exceeds C04's 2.46318 dB threshold; indeed every distance exceeds its condition-specific threshold (C02 3.37736 dB, C03 3.22764 dB, C04 2.46318 dB). The figures and measurements support rejection: Q01 uniquely combines an approximately 0.94 kHz line cluster, strong 100 Hz–4 kHz power, and approximately 3.535 Hz periodic bursting, whereas C02 and C04 emphasize approximately 16 kHz structure and C03 is dominated below 100 Hz. All reports have matched 10 s duration, 44.1 kHz sampling, frequency axes, and analysis resolution, so these discrepancies are not attributable to coverage or sampling-rate differences; absolute FS levels remain gain-dependent.
